name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=spell, descriptor=grant_spell_to_char). Accurately describes the function: it marks a spell as learned for a runtime character by OR-ing the spell's bit into the character's spells_known_bitmap. No Ghidra address residue; no embedded domain IDs to preserve.
purpose: Mark spell_id as learned for the runtime character at char_idx by setting the corresponding bit in that character's 5-byte spells_known_bitmap.
logic_summary: Copies the 8-byte single-bit mask table (data_fd2_battle_spell_bit_mask_lookup_table @ 0x52024 = {1,2,4,8,0x10,0x20,0x40,0x80}) into a local array (mirrors the binary's MOVSD-to-stack), computes pChar = data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr + char_idx, then OR-sets pChar->spells_known_bitmap[spell_id/8] |= bit_mask_table[spell_id % 8] (= 1 << (spell_id % 8)). The binary uses signed div/mod by 8, but spell_id is always a small non-negative id so plain /8 and %8 reproduce it. __cdecl, void return.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: char_idx: index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (runtime_char, stride 0x50) selecting the character that learns the spell.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_1; src already uses char_idx. Rename to char_idx to align Ghidra with src and reflect actual use (runtime char array index). Applied in Stage 2.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: spell_id: spell identifier 0x00..0x23 (36 spells); decomposed into byte offset (spell_id/8) and bit index (spell_id%8) within spells_known_bitmap.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_2; src already uses spell_id. Rename to spell_id to align Ghidra with src and reflect actual use (spell identifier). Applied in Stage 2.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the in-place bit set on the character's spells_known_bitmap.
